current_activity: takes its first division, the 87th, in Third Army; had been assigned to Third Army since 10 October
notes: Event date: 4 December 1944 (CMH table of the 87th Division lists III Corps as its corps from 4 December; Lorraine p299: the III Corps headquarters, newly arrived in Normandy, was assigned to the Third Army on 10 October and "as yet commanded only a few corps troops"). Event definition: III Corps becomes operational as a command of fighting divisions; Third Army has had the headquarters since 10 October and the CMH division tables first show it commanding a division, the 87th, on 4 December (the 11th Armored Division table shows III Corps from 2 October while that division was still in England, a table quirk the row does not use). The 10 October date is the assignment, which the row does not take as its event date. Relationship: Third Army assigned from 10 October (Lorraine p299). Location: Atlas lists the corps command post at Étain on 2 November and Gravelotte on 8 December; the later entry is used (four days). Coordinates: Wikipedia (en): Gravelotte. Event support: moderate (a Green Book statement for the assignment and a CMH table date for the first division). Location support: low (four days before the later atlas entry; the 2 November Étain entry is 32 days earlier).

current_activity: III Corps counterattack begins from Habay-la-Neuve and Arlon with the 26th, 80th and 4th Armored
notes: Event date: 22 December 1944 (Ardennes p509: D-day for the counterattack was 22 December; p524: at 0600 on 22 December, H-hour for the III Corps counterattack, two combat commands stood ready behind a line of departure from Habay-la-Neuve east to Niedercolpach; p509: the corps headquarters had been agreed on the night of 18 December to move from Metz to Arlon, and its divisions were the 26th, 80th and 4th Armored). Event definition: III Corps (Millikin) attacks north toward Bastogne; the point is the middle of the line of departure on the Arlon-Bastogne axis, not the headquarters. Relationship: Third Army assigned (Lorraine p299). Location: Habay-la-Neuve, on the Arlon-Bastogne axis at the line of departure named in the Green Book; the corps command post at Arlon is not dated for the day. Coordinates: Wikipedia (fr): Habay-la-Neuve. Event support: high (Green Book narrative). Location support: moderate (a representative sector point with a named line of departure).
